Planned full Rogun hydropower station: six 600 MW units, not current installed or delivered output. Active construction documented August 2025; completion not inferred. Published full-build annual generation forecast: 17 TWh; not measured current production.
Homer City redevelopment design: up to 4,500 MW gas-fired generation, separate from data-center IT load. Under construction; partial generation forecast 2027 is not achieved output.
Under construction. 5,200 MW solar PV design and separate 19 GWh storage; intended continuous supply is 1,000 MW, not additional generation. Planned operation 2027.
Embalse refurbishment completed 2019: published 683 MWe following 6% uprate. Source does not specify net/gross; not incremental 683 MW added by refurbishment.
Historical Browns Ferry Unit 1 restoration output reported as 1,065 MW electrical in 2007 account. Commercial return August 1, 2007; not a claim about later uprated capacity.
Historical TMI-1 net electrical rating 819 MWe in shutdown inventory. Original commercial operation 1974; shutdown 2019. No present output or completion of Crane restart asserted.
Historical TMI-2 design net electrical capacity 906 MWe. Commercial operation 1978, permanent shutdown March 1979; not current generation.
Historical Palisades original-build account: 760 MW electrical, commercial generation December 31, 1971. Net/gross unspecified in cited account; no completion of modern restart asserted.
Planned up-to-400 MW solar generation at High Spring. December 2027 operation schedule remains forecast; not operating power.
Planned 270 MW South Ripley solar generation. Proposed project with Q4 2027 operation forecast, not current operating capacity.
Proposed Fort Covington 250 MW solar generation. Developer page has conflicting June 2028, Q4 2028 and legacy 2027 forecasts; exact commissioning date unresolved.
Proposed Garnet 200 MW solar generation. Latest application describes 1,054.1-acre site and 901.6-acre fenced footprint. Not operating capacity.
Approximately 200 MW proposed new Allen aeroderivative generation: six GE LM2500 turbines. Excludes existing units 19 and 20; September 2025 decision alone does not prove physical work.
Shimane Unit 2: 789 MWe net (820 MWe gross), not incremental capacity from safety upgrades. Commercial operation resumed January 10, 2025.
Onagawa Unit 2: 825 MW BWR rating; net/gross not specified in operator restart notice. Commercial operation resumed December 26, 2024; not incremental upgrade capacity.

Three Gorges: 22,500 MW total including 32 main 700 MW and two 50 MW auxiliaries; full commercial operation 2012. Cited 2012 engineering account projects more than 100 TWh/year at full build; forecast generation, not measured annual output or site consumption.
Crane restart proposal: 835 MW restored nuclear generation, not current operating output. Under refurbishment; latest opened operator forecast 2027, dependent on NRC review and permits.
Silver Star federal 2024 initiation notice: 650 MW AC solar proposal. Separate battery 650 MW in project description versus 500 MW in objectives; battery final sizing unresolved. No MWh inferred.

Historical original design net ratings: Units 1 and 2 each 732 MWe, combined 1,464 MWe. Not current uprated output or incremental restart capacity. Both returned in 2012. Unit 2 corroboration: https://world-nuclear.org/nuclear-reactor-database/details/BRUCE-2
